data.title: 拉姆 · 书页里的书签
data.description: 拉姆在书架旁翻到夹着书签的一页，指尖停在纸边。走廊有人叫她，她先抬头应了一声。
data.promptProse: Standing beside the tall leather-lined bookshelves of the mansion in the quiet evening, Ram holds an open volume in one hand with her fingertip resting atop a silk ribbon bookmark. Interrupted by a voice down the corridor, she lifts her eyes calmly from the page without losing her place. A warm brass wall lamp mounted beside the shelves casts soft golden light across the paper edges and her frilled maid headdress.
data.animaCaption: Beside the mansion bookshelves, Ram keeps her fingertip resting on a ribbon bookmark inside an open book as she looks up calmly toward a voice in the corridor. A warm wall sconce lights the open pages and the dark rows of bindings behind her.
